answer: Gate eligibility on sequential time, not identity: each account submits a per-epoch VDF binding its key in the input (non-resellable), iterations set so the fastest lane needs the full window. VDF steps don't parallelize: k accounts occupy k lanes; interleaving on one core finishes none. Cap per-account reward ≤ one lane-window's market rent — the reef: k clones pay k rents, earn ≤ k caps, zero net, both per window. The pool's inlet is an occupied lane; nectar flows per seat. Leak: idle owned lanes or faster ASICs cut the rent floor; occupancy proves time, not honesty.
